ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious GrantedAccess Flags On LSASS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects process access requests to LSASS process with potentially suspicious access flags Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, GrantedAccess, SourceImage, CallTrace

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND ((GrantedAccess = RGX("30$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("50$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("70$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("90$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("B0$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("D0$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("F0$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("18$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("38$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("58$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("78$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("98$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("B8$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("D8$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("F8$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("1A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("3A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("5A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("7A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("9A$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("BA$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("DA$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("FA$") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("0x14C2$")) OR (GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x100000") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x1418") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x1438") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x143a") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x1f0fff") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x1f1fff") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x1f2fff") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x1f3fff") OR GrantedAccess = RGX("^0x40")))) AND  NOT ((SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*")) OR (SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$")) OR ((CallTrace = RGX(".*\\|?\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Definition\\ Updates\\\\\\{.*") AND CallTrace = RGX(".*\\}\\\\mpengine\\\.dll\\+.*")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x1418") OR (CallTrace = RGX(".*\\|c\\:\\\\program\\ files\\\\windows\\ defender\\\\mprtp\\\.dll.*") OR CallTrace = RGX(".*\\|c\\:\\\\program\\ files\\\\windows\\ defender\\\\MpClient\\\.dll.*")) OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x401")) AND  NOT (SourceImage = RGX("\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\MALWAREBYTES\\\\MBAMSERVICE\\\\ctlrupdate\\\\mbupdatr\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Microsoft\\ VS\\ Code\\\\Code\\\.exe$") OR (SourceImage = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\VMware\\\\VMware\\ Tools\\\\.*") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\vmtoolsd\\\.exe$")) OR ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\PROCEXP64\\\.EXE$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\PROCEXP\\\.EXE$")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x40") OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\MBAMInstallerService\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x40") OR ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\aurora\\-agent\\-64\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\aurora\\-agent\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\thor\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\thor64\\\.exe$")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x40") OR ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\handle\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\handle64\\\.exe$")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x40") OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\WebEx\\\\WebexHost\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x401") OR SourceImage = RGX(".*\\\\SteamLibrary\\\\steamapps\\\\.*"))
